facts.fact: 1975 年 9 月信：小 Stefano 开学，喜欢老师和朋友
facts.anchor: scool started again

facts.fact: 女老师因男友死于战争穿黑丧服
facts.anchor: her boyfriend died in the war and she said she has to wear blak forever

facts.fact: Mama 的生死观：走了的要放手，活着的要享受
facts.anchor: people who go need to be let go, and people who stay have to enjoy life

facts.fact: Stefano 自述能清楚看见火焰、疑心自己出过体，Mama 提醒人常出错
facts.anchor: I can see the flame real well and yesterday I think I even went out

facts.fact: 1977 年 3 月信：Mama 称那位先生为礼帽男/伯爵
facts.anchor: Mama calls him the Man in the Top Hat, or Count

facts.fact: 礼帽男赠 Stefano 一柄闪亮的军刀 sabre
facts.anchor: he gave me something, a kind of little sword, all shiny, he called it a sabre

facts.fact: Mama 评价：礼帽男不算坏人但必须小心
facts.anchor: Mama said that the Man in the Top Hat is a person you have to be careful with

facts.fact: Mama 逼他保证永不与礼帽男打牌
facts.anchor: she made me promise that I would never play cards with him

facts.fact: 1979 年 12 月冬至信：Mama 与王（Leo）布置了 Diana 神庙
facts.anchor: Mama and the King, that is Leo, had prepared the Temple of Diana

facts.fact: 冬至仪式全员裸体在林中（英国人 Gardner 称 skyclad）
facts.anchor: We were all naked in the wood

facts.fact: 仪式中想象圆周为蓝色球体
facts.anchor: We had to see, with our imagination, the circle as if it was a blue sphere

facts.fact: Leo 念诵的祷句首行：The centre holds
facts.anchor: The centre holds.

facts.fact: 1979 年 12 月：苏联入侵阿富汗，众人结力锥限制伤害
facts.anchor: the Soviets invading Afghanistan. In fact we made a cone of power to limit the damage

facts.fact: Stefano 在 Yule 节认识同龄女孩 Irene，两人将满十四岁一起受启蒙
facts.anchor: I met a really nice girl at Yule, she’s called Irene

facts.fact: 1987 年信：朋友与警察冲突、邀他加入，他没兴趣
facts.anchor: They tried to persuade me to join in, but the whole thing didn’t interest me

facts.fact: 1987 年：Stefano 读美国人 Wilson 与 Leary 论致幻与性爱自由
facts.anchor: I started reading some Americans, like Robert Anton Wilson and Timothy Leary

facts.fact: Stefano 最终入读医学
facts.anchor: I did matriculate in Medicine, in the end

facts.fact: 1991 年 2 月信：Stefano 爱上同车去 Nemi 的法课女生 Silvia
facts.anchor: Her name is Silvia

facts.fact: Silvia 的信仰缺陷清单：公教、反对离婚堕胎毒品
facts.anchor: she’s Catholic

facts.fact: 一位非洲主教的文章说天主教本不在受难而在复活
facts.anchor: the true meaning of the Gospels isn’t in the death of Jesus, but in his resurrection

facts.fact: Stefano 判意大利：无真实替代，连无神论者内核都是公教徒
facts.anchor: in Italy we lack a real alternative. Even the atheists are just Catholics at the core

facts.fact: 1992 年 2 月信：Stefano 结识奥古斯托·达尔·马雷
facts.anchor: He’s called Augusto Dal Mare

facts.fact: Leo 带 Dal Mare 参加上届牧神节使其入 Would 会
facts.anchor: Leo brought him to the last Lupercalia, to initiate him into the Coven

facts.fact: Dal Mare 自称家族在 Would 会之外习巫术数百年
facts.anchor: His family has practiced the Art for centuries, outside any coven

facts.fact: 1992 年 9 月：Equinox 节上 Stefano「杀死」Leo 继任林中之王
facts.anchor: I’m the new King of the Woods!

facts.fact: Dal Mare 剑术出色常用军刀与手杖剑
facts.anchor: Augusto is a brilliant swordsman

facts.fact: 1996 年 4 月：婚礼仪式本身糟糕，但夫妇情深足矣
facts.anchor: the ceremony was horrendous

facts.fact: Dal Mare 当伴郎无可挑剔并帮他挑西装
facts.anchor: Augusto was an impeccable best man

facts.fact: 1988 年（原文 2001 年 8 月）信：女儿出生，Stefano 用 wondrous 形容
facts.anchor: She’s wondrous, there’s nothing else to say

facts.fact: 女儿取名 Angela 随母名
facts.anchor: Silvia wants to call her Angela, after her mother

facts.fact: 女儿出生后 Stefano 开始研究共同的岛之梦
facts.anchor: research on dreams, and one in particular, experienced by many different people regarding an island

facts.fact: Stefano 与父亲仅见过一面，那句话最珍贵
facts.anchor: The advice you gave me the only time we met is the most precious I’ve ever received

facts.fact: 2005 年 11 月：Stefano 确信岛在本体论上真实
facts.anchor: I’m convinced that the Island is ontologically real

facts.fact: 三领域之名由父亲（收信人）所定：Aspects
facts.anchor: You called them the Aspects: Flesh, Enchantment, and Dream

facts.fact: Stefano 的框架：岛在 Enchantment，经由 Dream 抵达
facts.anchor: the Island is in Enchantment, but may be reached through Dream

facts.fact: 2008 年 12 月：流浪汉 Carlo 被送急诊，讲述岛上被孩童锁洞穴的经历
facts.anchor: A vagrant arrived in the emergency room, half-frozen and stinking of alcohol and worse

facts.fact: Carlo 腕上锁链痕清晰可见，急诊同事仍不愿承认
facts.anchor: The vagrant still had the marks of a chain on his wrists, red and quite visible

facts.fact: Carlo 行踪：1989 年球赛后失踪一年，妻子家暴受害者
facts.anchor: he disappeared around a year ago, and he was seen for the last time after the match

facts.fact: 2009 年 10 月信：Stefano 肉身登岛
facts.anchor: I have been to the Island

facts.fact: 登岛法近似星体投射，用整个身体
facts.anchor: it was very similar to astral projection, except that you do it with your whole body

facts.fact: 仙子告知：角神被流放、正准备近期回归
facts.anchor: told me that he had been exiled, but he is preparing to return in the near future

facts.fact: 2012 年 2 月：Stefano 转向濒死体验研究
facts.anchor: I mean to embark on a new line of inquiry: NDEs, Near Death Experiences

facts.fact: 同信末行独立成句：奥古斯托不同意
facts.anchor: Augusto disagrees

facts.fact: 2012 年 7 月：岛上的孩子说 Peter 未归，反派 Hook 从未离开、随意穿梭领域
facts.anchor: the children gave me chills, they say that Peter Pan is still not there, but the villain, Captain Hook, never left

facts.fact: Stefano 的结论：Peter 是角神/Pan 的一面
facts.anchor: Peter Pan is one face of the Horned God, Pan himself

facts.fact: Dal Mare 半真半笑引一首 Bennato 旧歌质疑 Peter 是英雄
facts.anchor: He quoted to me, half-serious and half-joking, an old Bennato song

facts.fact: 2012 年 11 月信：好友即虎克克
facts.anchor: Augusto Dal Mare, my best friend, is Captain Hook

facts.fact: 独立成段的两词判决
facts.anchor: He is a god.

facts.fact: 最初疑点：岛上孩子沙滩画出的帆船与 Dal Mare 花园雕塑无异
facts.anchor: a child drew Hook’s Galleon in the sand

facts.fact: Dal Mare 摊牌自陈：我是控制历史者
facts.anchor: “I am the one that keeps history under control,” he said

facts.fact: Dal Mare 的招揽方案：阻止 Peter 回归、一切照旧
facts.anchor: We will avoid Peter Pan’s return

facts.fact: Stefano 用非常手段说服期刊发表岛的论文
facts.anchor: desperate times call for desperate measures

facts.fact: 论文于 13 日刊出（呼应 ch09：Nov 2012, p23）
facts.anchor: The article was published today, on the 13th

facts.fact: 赴会前 Stefano 藏军刀于夹克内袋（Irene 缝的）
facts.anchor: I hid the sabre under my jacket

facts.fact: 只有礼帽男所赠之刃能伤传说
facts.anchor: An ordinary sword, forged simply in Flesh, wouldn’t hurt a legend

facts.fact: Dal Mare 邀他做二把手
facts.anchor: “and we will take every decision together.”

facts.fact: Stefano 质问：你说你是虎克克，钩子在哪
facts.anchor: where’s the Hook?

facts.fact: Dal Mare 答：太久远了，神也会变
facts.anchor: “That was so long ago,” he said. “Even gods change.”

facts.fact: Dal Mare 自称最想消灭的恰是暴力
facts.anchor: Violence is a means, not an end

facts.fact: 谈判破裂：Dal Mare 率先掷刀偷袭
facts.anchor: that bastard threw a knife at me!

facts.fact: 决斗中场景在书房与海上礁岩间切换
facts.anchor: we were in his studio, then we were on a rock in the open sea

facts.fact: Stefano 一剑刺穿左大腿并上挑致其跪地
facts.anchor: I placed a decisive blow, piercing the muscle of his left thigh

facts.fact: 未杀理由自供：不是高尚，是没胆
facts.anchor: It wasn’t any noble sentiment that stopped me. It was lack of courage

facts.fact: 不后悔的根据：顺了自己的本性
facts.anchor: I followed my nature

facts.fact: 间章末句：写结局的或许是孙辈
facts.anchor: Perhaps they will be the ones to write the ending
